methodologyNotes: Pricing gathered by fetching official vendor pages, the Audible newsroom, the Scribd/Everand help center, Rakuten Kobo, Publishers Weekly, and reputable 2026 comparison articles (DealNews, MakeHeadway, Book Riot). Many vendor pricing pages are JavaScript-rendered or returned 403/503; figures were corroborated against at least two independent 2026 sources where possible. Adversarial verification pass (2026-06-14) corrected several stale figures: Audible Plus is $7.95 and Premium Plus $14.95 (not the older $7.99/$15.99 App Store figures); Audible annual is $149.50/yr for 12 credits (not $159.99). Everand moved from a flat unlimited model to a credit-based three-tier model (Standard/Plus/Deluxe) in late 2024 — the old $9.99 unlimited and $84.99 annual figures are obsolete and were replaced with the current confirmed tiers. Kobo Plus Listen is $7.99 (not $9.99) and Read & Listen is $9.99 (not the previously inferred $13.99), confirmed via Book Riot. Libro.fm launched an annual plan ($169.99/yr, 12+1 credits) in 2025 — the prior 'no annual option' claim was stale and an annual plan has been added. Non-telephony service: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on all plans.

vendors.name: Audible
vendors.provenance: Current US pricing confirmed via the Audible newsroom (Standard $8.99, Premium $14.95) and two independent June 2026 comparison sources: DealNews 'How Much Does Audible Cost in June 2026' (Plus $7.95/mo, Premium Plus $14.95/mo, Premium Plus Annual 12 credits $149.50/yr) and MakeHeadway 'How Much Is Audible in 2026' (same figures). Prior App Store figures of $7.99/$15.99/$159.99 are stale and were corrected.

plans.name: Audible Plus
plans.notes: Unlimited access to the Plus Catalog (curated library of audiobooks, podcasts, and Originals included at no extra cost); does not include a monthly credit for premium titles. 30-day free trial for new members. Corrected from stale $7.99 App Store figure to current $7.95.

plans.name: Audible Premium Plus
plans.notes: Includes 1 credit/month redeemable for any premium title (including new releases) regardless of price, Plus Catalog access, and 30% off additional purchases. Month-to-month rate $14.95. Corrected from stale $15.99 App Store figure. Confirmed by Audible newsroom and two June 2026 comparison sources.

plans.name: Audible Premium Plus Annual (12 Credits)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $149.50/year for 12 credits delivered upfront (~$12.46/mo effective, ~$12.46 per credit). Includes Plus Catalog access. Month-to-month Premium Plus rate is $14.95/mo. Corrected from stale $159.99/year ($13.33/mo) figure.

vendors.name: Everand
vendors.provenance: Formerly Scribd (rebranded 2023). In late 2024 Everand replaced its flat unlimited model with a credit-based three-tier model. Current US pricing confirmed directly from the official Scribd/Everand help center 'Everand plans: Standard, Plus, and Deluxe' (accessed 2026-06-14): Standard $11.99/mo (1 unlock), Plus $16.99/mo (3 unlocks), Deluxe $28.99/mo (5 unlocks). The old $9.99 unlimited monthly and $84.99 annual figures are obsolete and were removed.

plans.name: Everand Standard
plans.notes: Credit-based plan: 1 unlock per month for premium audiobooks/ebooks, plus unlimited access to a curated catalog (Everand Originals, podcasts, sheet music, and rotating titles). Replaced the former $9.99 unlimited model after the late-2024 restructuring. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Everand Plus
plans.notes: Credit-based plan: 3 unlocks per month for premium titles, plus the same curated unlimited catalog access. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Everand Deluxe
plans.notes: Credit-based plan: 5 unlocks per month for premium titles, plus the same curated unlimited catalog access. 30-day free trial.

vendors.name: Libro.fm
vendors.provenance: Monthly membership $14.99/mo (1 credit) confirmed via WebSearch and Libro.fm support pages. Libro.fm launched an annual plan in 2025, confirmed by Publishers Weekly 'Libro.fm Launches Annual Subscription' (accessed 2026-06-14): $169.99/year for 12 credits plus a limited-time bonus 13th credit. The prior 'no annual option' claim was stale and an annual plan has been added.

plans.name: Libro.fm Standard (Monthly)
plans.notes: 1 credit per month redeemable for any audiobook (600,000+ titles). Credits never expire. Purchases support local independent bookstores. 30% off additional a la carte purchases. New members can get the first month for $0.99.

plans.name: Libro.fm Annual
plans.notes: Billed annually at $169.99/year for 12 credits delivered upfront (~$14.17/mo effective), plus a limited-time bonus 13th credit. Same independent-bookstore-supporting model as monthly. Launched 2025; confirmed by Publishers Weekly.

vendors.name: Kobo Plus
vendors.provenance: Official kobo.com plans page returned 403; US pricing confirmed via Book Riot 'Kobo Plus Review' (accessed 2026-06-14): Kobo Plus Read $7.99/mo, Kobo Plus Listen $7.99/mo, Kobo Plus Read & Listen $9.99/mo. Corrected the prior Listen figure ($9.99) and the previously inferred Read & Listen figure ($13.99), both of which were wrong.

plans.name: Kobo Plus Read
plans.notes: Unlimited ebook access only; no audiobooks. Free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Kobo Plus Listen
plans.notes: Unlimited audiobook access only; no ebooks. Corrected from the prior $9.99 figure to the confirmed $7.99. Free trial for new subscribers.

plans.name: Kobo Plus Read & Listen
plans.notes: Combined unlimited ebook and audiobook access. Corrected from the previously inferred $13.99 to the confirmed $9.99. Free trial for new subscribers.

vendors.name: Audiobooks.com
vendors.provenance: Standard 1-credit plan at $14.95/month (1 credit + 1 VIP book, 30-day free trial with 3 free books) confirmed via official audiobooks.com pricing page and WebSearch (2026-06-14). Audiobooks.com also offers 2- and 3-credit monthly plans and a $149.40/year annual prepaid plan; only the standard 1-credit plan is listed here.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 1 credit per month for any audiobook plus access to 1 VIP (bonus) book. VIP selection rotates monthly. Cancel anytime. 30-day free trial with 3 free audiobooks. 2- and 3-credit plans and a $149.40/yr annual prepaid plan also exist.

vendors.name: Downpour
vendors.provenance: Official downpour.com/pages/membership confirms $12.99/month for 1 credit, month-to-month only (no annual option). Corroborated by June 2026 WebSearch (TopConsumerReviews, TechRadar) confirming $12.99/mo unchanged through 2026.

plans.name: Downpour Audiobook Club
plans.notes: 1 credit per month redeemable for ~97% of the catalog. Credits expire 12 months after purchase. Up to 70% off retail prices. Additional credits available at $12.99 each. Cancel anytime. No annual billing option.

vendors.name: Chirp
vendors.provenance: Official chirpbooks.com and the Chirp about page confirm a pay-per-book model with no subscription fee. Deals typically $0.99-$5.99 per title. Owned by the team behind BookBub. Corroborated by June 2026 WebSearch.

plans.name: Pay-Per-Book (No Subscription)
plans.notes: No subscription required. Audiobooks purchased individually at deal prices, typically $0.99-$5.99 per title (limited-time deals, up to 95% off). Free to sign up for daily deal emails. Books purchased are owned permanently. No recurring fee.

vendors.name: AudiobooksNow
vendors.provenance: Official audiobooksnow.com Club sign-up page confirms Club Pricing at $4.99/month with a 30-day free trial and 50% off first audiobook each month. Monthly rate ($4.99/mo) corroborated by June 2026 WebSearch. Annual rate ($35.99/year) is from the official homepage but could not be independently re-confirmed in this verification pass; the annual figure is retained from the official source.

plans.name: Club Pricing (Monthly)
plans.notes: Provides discounted per-book pricing on any audiobook (not a credit system) plus 50% off the first purchase each month (rolls over if unused). Annual option $35.99/year (~$3.00/mo effective). 30-day free trial. Books owned permanently.

plans.name: Club Pricing (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually at $35.99/year (~$3.00/mo effective, ~40% discount vs the $4.99 monthly plan). Same discounted per-book pricing benefits as monthly plan. Annual figure from official homepage; not independently re-confirmed in this verification pass.

plans.name: Pay-As-You-Go (No Membership)
plans.notes: No subscription fee. Purchase audiobooks at standard (non-club) prices without any commitment. Books owned permanently.
